home.title: Home
home.balanceHint: Backed 1:1 by USDT held at your sarraf

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.subtitle: Request a deposit from your sarraf
deposit.noSarraf: You are not a member of a sarraf yet. Ask a sarraf to add you.
deposit.requested: Request sent to your sarraf. Your balance updates once they issue.
deposit.howItWorks: You hand cash or USDT to your sarraf. They deposit backing on-chain and issue you the same amount of IOU — always fully funded, never more than their backing.
deposit.onchainHint: For sarrafs: deposit USDT backing straight into the reserve pool.

send.title: Send
send.subtitle: Send IOU to anyone, instantly
send.methodDirectHint: Sends on-chain from your wallet now
send.methodCourierHint: Sign an offline authorization; anyone can relay it for you
send.authorizationSigned: Authorization signed. Share it with a courier to relay, or relay it yourself.

redeem.exitHint: Redemption is the exit door — everyday payments are free
